patient_profile.diagnosis_summary: Adult female with acute migraine headaches.

request.requested_disposition: Coverage approval for Nurtec ODT for acute migraine

denial_rationale: Insurer denied Nurtec ODT, stating the current outpatient notes on file did not document trial and failure of triptans.

known_facts.text: Patient has a diagnosis of acute migraine headaches.
Patient has previously tried and failed Sumatriptan, Zolmitriptan, and Rizatriptan (ineffective or intolerable side effects), per provider report.
The specific outpatient notes submitted with the original request did not themselves document this triptan trial/failure history.

treatment_or_claim_history.description: Trials of Sumatriptan, Zolmitriptan, and Rizatriptan; reported ineffective or caused intolerable side effects.

available_evidence.description: Provider report describing prior triptan trials and outcomes
Outpatient clinical notes documenting the triptan trials contemporaneously

unknowns: Why the original outpatient notes did not document the triptan trial history that the provider later reported.
Dates and dosing details of each triptan trial.
